email.subject: Rapid Plumbing's site may be losing calls
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I took a quick look at Rapid Plumbing's website. Two things stood out: it doesn't display properly on phones, and there's no tap-to-call button — so mobile visitors (most plumbing searches) can't easily reach you and likely just call the next listing instead.

I also noticed no customer reviews are shown and the footer still has outdated info, which can make visitors hesitate before calling.

I fix these kinds of issues for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
